Mrs. Fisher: Did you really catch that huge halibut? Color me surprised.
Mrs. Fisher: It seems like a boy became a man overnight. How long ago did you start fishing again? Truly impressive.
You: Thanks!
Mrs. Fisher: Halibut is the heaviest fish you can catch around here, but I hope you won’t be discouraged by the fact that you have already caught probably the biggest monster in these waters. 
Mrs. Fisher: It would be a huge loss for our community if you were to stop fishing. I wouldn't want to see such a talent go to waste.
Mrs. Fisher: On the other hand, there would be more fish in the waters without you so please, think about retiring already.
You: How rude! 
Mrs. Fisher: Another important lesson learned, kid. Fishers are quite jealous creatures.
You: I’m a kid again? I thought that you told me that I became a man overnight! 
Mrs. Fisher: For me you will always be a kid, kid. My age is a secret, but I could definitely be your mother hahaha~
You: …
